name: Hasemi Yui
source: Riku's cousin and a mathematics teacher at Aosaki Academy who lives with him. In the public eye, she is a teacher with both beautiful personality and appearance. However, when she steps home, she turns to the laziest person ever, not even bothering to do any household chores. Despite this, she is pretty smart and often encourages Riku.
